{{Quote|If you can pass white-hat training, you're a white-hat.|Isila Drutch|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
'''Isila Drutch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Parshoone]], [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] prior to [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]] into a family affiliated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At the age of seventeen, Drutch applied to an [[Army/Legends|army]] concentration in the [[Parshoone Sector Service Academy]], and after a [[Standard year/Legends|year]], transferred to the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], an [[Imperial Academy/Legends|elite military institution]], after passing the test. Four years of hard training later, Drutch became a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in the [[291st Legion/Legends|291st Legion Dalisor]], with a designation of '''TD-4388'''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Four years later I walked the edge and earned my white hat&mdash;now I wasn't Drutch anymore but TD-4388, 291st Legion Dalisor.|Isila Drutch on becoming a stormtrooper|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
Isila Drutch, a [[Gender/Legends|female]], was from the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Parshoone]],<ref name="Warfare" /> and was born prior to [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]].<ref name="Note" /> Her [[Isila Drutch's father|father]] served on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Archer (Tector-class)|''Archer'']] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the Republic, which would later be transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Even though her [[Parent/Legends|father]] talked about his [[Navy/Legends|navy]] [[Standard day/Legends|days]], Drutch was one for [[Ground warfare/Legends|solid ground]]. She grew up drawing fortifications and arranging skirmish lines instead of playing with [[Tooka doll/Legends|Tooka dolls]].<ref name="Warfare" />

As Drutch grew up, she was never idle and worked with the rest of the Parshoone inhabitants. At the age of seventeen, she applied to the Imperial-aligned [[Parshoone Sector Service Academy]] where she trained in an [[Army/Legends|army]] concentration. After her first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] there, Drutch was at the top of her class, which caused the [[Parshoone Service Academy commandant|commandant]] to offer to sponsor her at the prestigious [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]]. Drutch instead asked for an alternative: the equally prestigious [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]. A [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Carida Academy)|major]] was sent out from [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] to assess Drutch, and took her through three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of very hard training, with Drutch not being able to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]] during the whole test. The [[Major/Legends|major]], having finished assessing her, approved her transfer to Carida. Drutch later arrived on Carida, and although she had to put up with the strange looks shot at her because she was female, they later subsided because she had proven herself as fit as any of them.<ref name="Warfare" />

After four years of training, Drutch became a part of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] as she joined the [[291st Legion/Legends|291st Legion Dalisor]], and was given the designation TD-4388. She became the first female [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in her [[Company/Legends|company]], though there were two others in her [[Legion/Legends|legion]]; [[TD-5144]] and [[TD-1123]]. While in the 291st, Drutch shared the [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] with the men even though she was female. Sometime after becoming a stormtrooper, Drutch was on leave in a low-quality [[Unidentified cantina (Isila Drutch)|cantina]] when some members of her squad pointed out a poster of a female stormtrooper in femtrooper gear, an overly feminized version of stormtrooper armor, to Drutch, and asked why Drutch was not in the right gear. This incident caused Drutch to laugh. In [[33 ABY/Legends|33 ABY]], Drutch was still with the 291st, though the Empire had been replaced with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], and she had a set of memoirs documenting her life.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|A lot of it is just ignorance: When my squad was all shelled up in white, you couldn't tell I was a woman. The only thing you could see was that I was a little short. A lot of civvies have probally stood a meter from a female stormtrooper and never known it.|Isila Drutch on female stormtroopers|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
Drutch was shorter than most stormtroopers and physically fit, so much so that she could endure a three day physical training assessment with no sleep. She could also shoot straighter and last longer in combat than most other [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. Drutch was a natural [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], drawing up military installations and forces instead of playing with dolls when she was young. Drutch chose the Academy of Carida over Raithal when the commandant offered to sponsor her.<ref name="Warfare" />

[[File:Lucky_Lekku_noseart.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Noseart of the ''[[Lucky Lekku/Legends|Lucky Lekku]]'', featuring a [[Twi'lek]] wearing the same kind of imaginary femtrooper gear deemed useless by Drutch.]]
During the four years of training to become a stormtrooper, Drutch's mindset was changed to only think like a stormtrooper, and she fought together with the other troopers even though she was female. Drutch had many views about female stormtroopers and thought that it was mainly due to ignorance that many people were not aware that there were female stormtroopers serving in the Corps. Drutch agreed that there were fewer females in the Stormtrooper Corps; she knew that was the case because there were no female [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] lines and because most females would not make it through to become a stormtrooper because of their physiology.<ref name="Warfare" />

When compared with a female in femtrooper gear, Drutch laughed. Drutch believed the femtrooper gear was useless due to a chest plate that appeared to have two [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]] and a bare midriff, with which Drutch recommended not going into combat.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Isila Drutch was first mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] as a guide dedicated to the conflicts in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].
